Sandbox_DazedPower_BankScale_tooltip: Scales how much every battery stores.
Sandbox_DazedPower_BarnStockChance: Storage barns with spare solar gear (one in)
Sandbox_DazedPower_BarnStockChance_toolt: On newly explored ground, one hay-storage barn in this many holds a few spare panels and battery racks. 0 means none.
Sandbox_DazedPower_StormRate_tooltip: How often a thunderstorm trips an unprotected system's isolator. A grounding rod near the controller stops it. 0 turns lightning off.
Sandbox_DazedPower_HydrogenRisk_tooltip: A Makeshift bank charged hard in a closed room builds up gas. You are warned first; ignoring it can end in a fire.
Sandbox_DazedPower_AgeRate_tooltip: How fast charge cycles wear cells for good. 100 is about 600 full cycles to lose a third of a cell; 0 turns ageing off.
Sandbox_DazedPower_DegradeBank_tooltip: Running batteries flat costs capacity permanently. Cheap chemistries start suffering far sooner than sealed ones.
Sandbox_DazedPower_GridLinkRadius_toolti: How far a transformer's power line can run, to the controller or to another transformer, in tiles.
Sandbox_DazedPower_LinkRadius_tooltip: How far each component reaches to find the next one. Banks chain, so a run of them can lead away from the controller.
Sandbox_DazedPower_OutputScale_tooltip: Scales everything the panels make. 100 is the physical model.
Sandbox_DazedPower_PickupLock: Who may pick up solar parts
Sandbox_DazedPower_PickupLock_option3: Whoever placed it, their safehouse, admins and moderators
Sandbox_DazedPower_PickupLock_tooltip: Panels and battery banks are expensive to build and trivial to carry off. Mods that remove the tool requirement for moving furniture otherwise make every rig free to take. On a server this also decides who may use a rig's controls: switching a controller, its cables, wiring buildings, and a backup generator's switches and fuel barrels. Anyone nearby may still read the monitor, clean panels, and refuel or repair a backup.
Sandbox_DazedPower_RealisticMode_tooltip: Panels make what panels made in 1993: three modules of about 50 W to a frame, so a standard frame gives about 140 W in full sun, a quarter of the usual. Makeshift frames make about half that, premium frames a little more. Backup generators burn gasoline like real generators: 0.15 L an hour for each kW of their rating, plus 0.45 L for each kWh they deliver.
Sandbox_DazedPower_RigChance: Houses with a solar rig (one in)
Sandbox_DazedPower_RigChance_tooltip: On newly explored ground, one house in this many has a solar rig in the yard. 0 means none.
Sandbox_DazedPower_SimulateLoad_tooltip: Count what the lights, fridges and ovens in range are drawing. Off means the system only ever charges.
Sandbox_DazedPower_SnowRate_tooltip: How fast snow covers the glass. 0 means it never settles. Roof panels collect faster and shed slower whatever this is set to.
Sandbox_DazedPower_SoilRate_tooltip: How fast dirt cuts output. Rain washes panels either way.
Sandbox_DazedPower_TransformerLoss_toolt: What each transformer draws while the system has power, even with nothing switched on.
Sandbox_DazedPower_CableTilesPerWire_too: How many tiles of cable one Electric Wire covers. A 6-tile lead at 4 costs 2 wire. Cutting a cable gives half back. 0 makes cables free.
Sandbox_DazedPower_LiveShock: Shock when wiring a live system
Sandbox_DazedPower_LiveShock_tooltip: Running or cutting a cable while the controller is switched on can burn the player's hand. The chance grows with the system's load and falls with Electricity skill. Never lethal.
Sandbox_DazedPower_FenceDamage_tooltip: A zap from a live electric fence takes a little health off the zombie as well as knocking it down. Off: it only knocks them down.
Sandbox_DazedPower_ColdStarts_tooltip: Below -5 C at the engine, a propane or petrol generator can fail to start, up to a 60% chance at -25 C. Makeshift engines fail more often, Workshop ones less. Keep the engine warm or try again.
Sandbox_DazedPower_RoomHeat: Heaters and coolers change room temperature
Sandbox_DazedPower_RoomHeat_tooltip: Needs Dazed Climate. A running Electric Space Heater warms the room it stands in and a running Room Cooler chills its room's air.
